item.text: {"paper_id":"paper074","profile_id":"cardiovascular","relevance":2,"evidence_quote":"This retrospective study explored the associations of plasma homocysteine (Hcy), cysteine (Cys) and methionine (Met) levels with 90-day prognosis in intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) patients and evaluated their predictive value for ICH prognosis.","rationale":"Biomarker prediction of intracerebral hemorrhage outcomes is relevant to the profile’s vascular disease interest, although its focus is cerebrovascular prognosis rather than cardiac disease, cardiovascular prevention, or therapies.","scope_ambiguous":true,"ambiguity_note":"The profile includes vascular disease but does not specify whether cerebrovascular conditions such as intracerebral hemorrhage fall within its cardiovascular scope."}
